title: chat-client: update blob methods from blobext-01 to -03
description: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/blob.rs cites blobext-01 section numbers (lines 3, 18, 49, 80, 112) and tests/blob_smoke_tests.rs too. Re-cite against -03 and check the client shapes: BlobObject.size is already Option<u64> (blob.rs:93), matching -03's UnsignedInt|null; add a test that size: null deserializes; check Blob/lookup and Blob/convert request/response fields and SetError names (invalidProperties/tooLarge/notFound) against -03.
